heroThesis: No telemetry. No racial discrimination. Every claim below is anchored to verbatim public statements, repository commits, pull requests, USPTO filings, and archived screenshots.
storyArcLead: A single naming dispute over a community MIT fork uncovered a pattern of racial double standards, hidden telemetry, silent security patches, and unfixed architectural risks.

storyArc.title: The discriminatory spark
storyArc.body: After a user mistook a Chinese developer's free MIT fork for official T3 Code, @theo called it a "Chinese knockoff" and "Temu3 Code" and threatened a GitHub account ban — despite holding 0 USPTO trademarks and publicly welcoming trillion-dollar US labs copying MIT code 11 hours later.

storyArc.title: Opening the source code
storyArc.body: Line-by-line inspection of pingdotgg/t3code revealed default-on PostHog telemetry shipped behind a "No telemetry" homepage promise, closed-source event retention at ingest.t3.codes, unsalted SHA-256 reads of ~/.codex and ~/.claude.json, 41.6 GB fake SQLite deletion, a 52-day silent git push --force bug, Google Antigravity header spoofing, and zero-E2E plaintext T3 Connect.

storyArc.title: 2.26M+ views, EU GDPR filing & 6-hour panic blitz
storyArc.body: Part 1 crossed 2.26 million views and triggered an EU GDPR complaint. Emergency overnight PRs inadvertently admitted 2.2M/hr IP + User-Agent logs kept 30 days in Axiom, absolute git.cwd workspace path leaks, broken account deletion, and ignored Windows/macOS opt-outs.

storyArc.title: What remains open today

mitigation.heading: 2-Minute Hardening & Cleanup Playbook
mitigation.lead: If T3 Code is already installed on your machine, do not rely on environment variables alone — AnalyticsService.ts:156 writes a local ID before checking opt-outs and DesktopShellEnvironment.ts omits OTEL_SDK_DISABLED. Combine environment flags, OS hosts blocking, offline SQLite compaction, and token revocation.
steps: Export DO_NOT_TRACK=1 and legacy telemetry kill switches, AND sinkhole ingest.t3.codes in /etc/hosts.
Quit T3 Code, inspect statev2.sqlite, run offline VACUUM;, or remove ~/.t3 completely.
Stop running personal Google AI / Antigravity accounts via T3-managed directories to protect your single appeal.
Disable Publish agent activity, unlink T3 Connect machines, request Clerk + relay deletion, and revoke T3 Code's GitHub OAuth app.
Never expose plaintext t3 up --lan without TLS, avoid 30-day non-DPoP Bearer tokens in CI, and scrub SSH_AUTH_SOCK / GITHUB_TOKEN before opening untrusted repos.
mitigation.alternativesBody: Developers highlighted Mirasim (@Mirasim_ADE), Paseo (@paseo_sh), Paradev (@ParadevAI), Cloudroom, Conductor, Emdash, and Orca. Before adopting any client, verify default-off telemetry, true local deletion, official CLI delegation without header spoofing, and client-side E2E encryption.
